name_reason: Compliant fd2_<domain=render>_<descriptor> name with no Ghidra address residue. Accurately reflects the purpose: render an integer value as decimal digit glyphs into a pixel buffer. 16 callers across UI/status/HUD renderers all use it for this. No change needed.
purpose: Render the integer `value` as `digit_count` decimal-digit glyph sprites into the pixel buffer at `dst` (6 px per column), drawing single overflow placeholder glyphs when the value exceeds the digit budget.
logic_summary: Clamp negative value to 0 (signed test). If digit_count==3 && value>999: blit one 'MAX' glyph (sprite_base_idx+10) and return. If digit_count==2 && value>=100: blit one fixed 'in99+' glyph (sprite 0x5D, color-agnostic) and return. Otherwise copy the 6-byte format template data_fd2_string_ui_render_decimal_format_template ("%0.5d") into a local buffer, overwrite byte[3] ('5') with ('0'+digit_count) to form "%0.Nd", sprintf the zero-padded decimal into a local digit buffer, then loop i=0..digit_count-1 blitting glyph sprite (sprite_base_idx + digit_buf[i] - '0') at dst + i*6. All glyphs come from data_fd2_ui_anim_sprite_sheet_ptr. Disassembly confirms signed comparisons (TEST/JGE clamp; CMP 0x3E7/JLE for >999; CMP 0x63/JLE for >=100) and the byte[3] overwrite (MOV BL,[digit_count]; ADD BL,0x30; MOV [ESP+0x17],BL).
signature: void __cdecl fd2_render_decimal_number_to_buffer(uint32 dst, uint32 stride, uint32 value, uint32 sprite_base_idx, uint32 digit_count)

params.name: dst
params.semantics: Destination linear pixel-buffer address where the first digit glyph is blitted; subsequent columns at dst + i*6.
params.reason: Descriptive, no address residue; matches usage (base blit address).

params.name: stride
params.semantics: Surface pitch in bytes (0x140 = 320 for the mode13h-style surfaces), forwarded to the blit helper.

params.name: value
params.semantics: Integer to render; treated as signed for the negative clamp and the overflow comparisons.

params.name: sprite_base_idx
params.semantics: Base index into the UI/anim sprite sheet for the '0'..'9' digit glyph run; selects digit color theme (0x2A white, 0x77 red boosted, 0x1F red HP/MP-full). sheet[base+10] is the 'MAX' overflow glyph.
params.reason: Precisely describes the parameter; no address residue. (protos.h currently spells this param 'x', which is weaker, but declarations are reconciled in Stage 2; the in-body name is correct.)

params.name: digit_count
params.semantics: Number of decimal columns to render (2 or 3 in all call sites); also drives the format width and the per-mode overflow rule.
params.reason: Clear and correct; no residue. (protos.h spells this 'digits'; reconciled in Stage 2.)

returns.semantics: No return value; effect is the blitted digit/placeholder glyphs in the destination buffer.

notes: Source comment block (rndstat.c lines 613-679) is already precise, accurate, and ASCII-clean; verified against decompilation and full disassembly (signed clamps, >999/>=100 overflow rules, fmt byte[3] overwrite, i*6 column stride, sprite_base+digit indexing). Format template bytes 25 30 2e 35 64 00 = "%0.5d" confirmed in strtab.c. Ghidra plate is consistent (more verbose) so left untouched. No logic touched. Name and all 5 params kept. Note for Stage 2: protos.h (line 730) declares 4th/5th params as 'x'/'digits'; canonical in-body names are sprite_base_idx/digit_count -- Stage 2 may align the prototype, but no rename is recorded here because the live function-body names are already correct.
